lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-intensity local maxima is present; the centroids are arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows spanning the visible lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-luminance vertical bands cross the horizontal rows at approximately 90-degree angles, with the highest-intensity pixel clusters located at the intersection nodes of these axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features extend horizontally across the mid and upper flank; each displays a clear light-to-shadow gradient transition along the vertical axis, indicating structural protrusion.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 7-10 high-intensity pixel clusters are distributed across the first dorsal fin's surface, with a higher concentration observed toward the base and trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller, unordered high-luminance spots is visible on the cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit, contrasting with the structured grid pattern of the flank.
